title: Basic Syscalls and musl/BusyBox Compatibility
summary: v1.7.0 focuses on completing basic syscall behavior and improving musl and BusyBox compatibility on RISC-V 64 and LoongArch64.
scope: The release should run the image-provided basic and BusyBox tests with their original commands and execution order while preserving the existing kernel regression baseline.

items.title: I/O polling
items.description: implement `ppoll` readiness checks, pipe close/error events, timeouts, signal masks, and wakeups so that the original BusyBox `while read` loop can run.

items.title: Process lifecycle
items.description: validate `fork`/`clone`, `execve`, `wait4`, exit status, and background process handling with the image binaries. Document remaining stopped/continued-child limitations.

items.title: File operations
items.description: complete directory-relative open, create, truncate, append, seek, vectored I/O, access checks, unlink, rename, and directory removal behavior.

items.title: File metadata and names
items.description: complete `fstat`/`newfstatat`/`statx` metadata and flags, and align filename capacity across VFS, tmpfs, and EXT4 overlay paths.

items.title: Time and timestamps
items.description: implement `utimensat` and file timestamp updates needed by `touch`; validate time-related calls used by musl and BusyBox.

items.title: Runtime interfaces
items.description: preserve `execve` arguments and environment, including `PATH`; resolve required `gettid`, `sendfile`, and terminal `ioctl` behavior or validate working fallbacks.

items.title: Memory mapping baseline
items.description: implement shared file pages and writeback, fix cached reads and file offsets, and unify VMA fault and COW handling across RISC-V and LoongArch with regression coverage.

items.title: Mapping consistency
items.description: synchronize `write`/`writev` and truncate with mapped pages; complete cache reclamation, overlay copy-up consistency, and shared-mapping validation on both architectures.

items.title: musl basic tests
items.description: run the image-provided basic syscall suite on both architectures, check return values and error paths, and track each remaining failure.

items.title: Original BusyBox commands
items.description: use each image's `busybox_testcode.sh` and `busybox_cmd.txt` as the test source of truth. Preserve all 55 command-list entries, shell context, working directory, and the `test.txt` file lifecycle.

items.title: System information
items.description: provide the process, memory, filesystem, and mount information required by `ps`, `free`, `uptime`, `df`, and `du`.

items.title: Device and log interfaces
items.description: provide kernel log access for `dmesg`, RTC operations for `hwclock`, and the terminal behavior required by the shipped BusyBox applets.

items.title: Mount test environment
items.description: prepare the FAT partition and `/dev/vda2` device expected by the basic mount tests, together with partition discovery and filesystem support. Track missing fixtures separately from syscall failures.

items.title: Architecture test matrix
items.description: validate musl basic and original BusyBox tests on RISC-V 64 and LoongArch64 while retaining EasyFS/tmpfs, process, memory, signal, and user-application regressions.

items.title: Failure diagnostics
items.description: save per-command results and logs by architecture, image, libc, and boot mode. Treat missing results, timeouts, early termination, and failed commands as failures even when the outer script returns zero; retain the original `false` exception.

items.title: Compatibility baseline
items.description: record image hashes and publish syscall/command support and validation results. Resolve or explicitly defer remaining kernel, fixture, and applet gaps before release.
